benches.name: synthetic
benches.defs:
# A comment
target PSU "Supply"
  interface lan 10.0.0.7:5025 scpi
  command output state=on|off "OUTP {state}"
  command set_voltage v=0..30V "VOLT {v}"
  command bad x=?? "X"
  command any a b=1..=2 "A {a}" -> value
  telemetry voltage V "MEAS:VOLT?" yellow 0..25 red 0..28
  telemetry current A "MEAS:CURR?"  # trailing note
  telemetry nope V "Q" yellow x..y
  what is this
target DEV "Device"
  interface serial socket://127.0.0.1:9001 json-crc16
  command ping "msg ping" -> ack
  telemetry state - "field state"
  telemetry fault_A - "bit faultFlags 5"
  telemetry temp °C "field temp ÷10"
benches.script:
# header comment

suite S
  group One
    test T-01 First [REQ-1, REQ-2]
      PSU.set_voltage 24 V
      PSU.output on
      measure PSU.voltage as v0
      PSU.set_voltage $v0 V
      check PSU.voltage 24 V ±2%
      check DEV.temp 20 °C .. 30 °C
      check DEV.temp 2 V .. 3 V
      check DEV.missing == 1
      check nothing == 1
      wait until DEV.state == "IDLE" within 5 s
      wait until DEV.state == "IDLE"
      wait soon
      cleanup
        PSU.output off
        DEV.ping -> ack
    test T-02 Second
      call T-01
      call T-99
      for n in 1, 2
        DEV.ping
        repeat 2
          log "loop"
      script
        x = tlm('DEV.state')

        record('got', 1)
      check got == 1
      script on bridge
        import os
        record('b', 2, 'V')
      check b < 3 V
      todo "later"
      NOPE.thing
      PSU.nothing 1
      PSU.set_voltage 1 2
      frobnicate
  test T-03 Directly in a suite
    log "ok"
  log "a step outside a test"
group Loose
  test T-04 No suite   
    ask "Fine?"

benches.name: no-trailing-newline
benches.script:
suite A
  test A-1 One
    log "x"
